描述_EN: cartier-bresson helped develop the street photography style that has influenced generations of photographers that followed. he documented the liberation of paris, the collapse of the nationalist regime in china, gandhi's funeral and the partitioning of berlin. he sought to capture the 'everyday' in his photographs and took great interest in recording human activity. he wrote, "for me the camera is a sketch book, an instrument of intuition and spontaneity, the master of the instant which, in visual terms, questions and decides simultaneously. it is by economy of means that one arrives at simplicity of expression." as a reporter and co-founder of the magnum photography agency, cartier-bresson accepted his responsibility to supply information to a world in a hurry. in order to 'give a meaning' to the world, one has to feel involved in what one frames through the viewfinder. the victoria and albert museum has over 440 photographs by henri cartier-bresson (1908-2004), a french photographer who is considered to be one of the fathers of photojournalism and masters of candid photography. this attitude requires concentration, discipline of mind, sensitivity, and a sense of geometry.
描述_ZN: 卡蒂埃-布列松帮助发展了街头摄影风格，影响了后来的几代摄影家。 他记录了巴黎的解放、中国民族主义政权的崩溃、甘地的葬礼和柏林的分治。 他试图在他的照片中捕捉 "日常"，并对记录人类活动表现出极大兴趣。 他写道："对我来说，相机是一本素描书，是直觉和自发性的工具，是瞬间的主人，在视觉方面，它同时质疑和决定。 它是通过经济手段来达到简单的表达。"作为一名记者和Magnum摄影机构的创始人之一，卡地亚-布列松接受了他的责任，向这个匆忙的世界提供信息。 为了给世界 "赋予意义"，一个人必须感觉参与到他通过取景器拍摄的东西中。 维多利亚和阿尔伯特博物馆有超过440张亨利-卡蒂尔-布列松（1908-2004）的照片，这位法国摄影师被认为是新闻摄影之父和坦率摄影的大师之一。 这种态度需要集中精力、心智的约束、敏感和几何感。
